caption: The page Your partner plan of the app EB | Easy Bundle Builder: Partner plan Everything unlocked on this store, Free on this store, always with the button Start free as a partner and the text Applies automatically to partner and development stores. No card, no trial clock., the list Every bundle type: Mix & Match, Pre-curated, Quantity Breaks, No bundle revenue limits, a shared Slack channel with the bundles team and Bundle Studio early access for client work, two cards (Partner program with a 20% revenue share and Bundle Studio) and a closed section What your clients will pay; the store name and avatar in the bottom left corner are hidden.

The opened section What your clients will pay with the text that clients pay by the monthly revenue their bundles generate, and the table Plan, Monthly bundle revenue and Price: Starter under $500 Free, Essential $500 to $3,000 at $29 a month, Growth $3,000 to $5,000 at $49, Scale $5,000 to $10,000 at $99, Pro $10,000 to $20,000 at $149 (1:1 onboarding), Advanced $20,000 to $30,000 at $199 (1:1 onboarding) and Elite from $30,000 (cut off at the bottom); the store name and avatar in the bottom left corner are hidden.

The lower part of the table with Elite $30,000 to $50,000 at $299, Premier $50,000 to $150,000 at $399, Enterprise $150,000 to $500,000 at $599 and Enterprise Plus $500,000 and above (Let's talk), and the section How revenue-based pricing works with two opened answers: You pay for the band your revenue lands in (a usage charge tops you up to the price of the plan that covers it; a Growth store doing $25,000 pays $199 that month) and Usage charges are capped (Shopify asks you to approve a monthly spending cap before any usage charge applies); the store name and avatar in the bottom left corner are hidden.

The Bundle Editor for the bundle Build Your Snowboard Gift Box with the status Unlisted, the notice App extension off - Bundle can't display with a Turn on button (not pressed), the assistant Breezy describing the bundle (one step Pick Your Snowboards, the category Automated Collection with 8 snowboards, the rule exactly 3 snowboards, a discount of 15% off at 3 items, status Unlisted) and a preview with snowboards and the text Add 3 product(s) to save 15%!; a chat bubble of the vendor with a message from a vendor staff member is in the lower right, and the photo and name of that person and the store avatar in the bottom left corner are hidden.
